data.long_meaning: The name Likeeta is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Likita', which means 'lotus' or 'lily'. In Hindu mythology, the lotus is a symbol of creation and purity. This name is often given to girls born in the auspicious month of Shravana (July-August) when the lotus flower blooms. The name Likeeta carries the meaning “Lily flower” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Likeeta usually hope their child will grow to embody lily flower and live with faith, good character and purpose.
